  case kind*: DecomposedKind
  of dkSingleton:
    single*: uint32          ## The decomposed codepoint.
  of dkPair:
    first*: uint32           ## First codepoint of the pair.
    second*: uint32          ## Second codepoint of the pair.
Canonical decomposition result. Which decomposition shape this holds.

  dkSingleton,              ## Single codepoint decomposition.
  dkPair                     ## Pair decomposition.
Decomposition shape.
